title: The Brothers' War: card flavor text

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Inventor and prince consort of Yotia who builds automatons and thopters in the war against his brother Mishra, and fills the sylex.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, who leads the Fallaji, learns to read the desert, is twisted by Gix, and levels Kroog.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Archaeologist who taught Urza and Mishra and who paid the price for their rivalry.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: Scholar and Tocasia's true heir who saw the sylex as a key to the past.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: Man who pressed the sylex into Loran's hands and urged her to run as Terisia City burned.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Queen of Kroog who urges her people to save others as the city walls fall.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker whose body could not travel far enough through time; his spirit was sent with Kaya's help and then set adrift.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped send Teferi's spirit through time.

entities.name: Drafna, Founder of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Founder of Lat-Nam who built a legacy of scholarship with his wife Hurkyl.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Wife of Drafna; teacher whose followers showed Mishra's army the secrets of the Third Path.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: Planeswalker who forged the temporal anchor with her will.

entities.name: Vayor
entities.description: Third Path cryomancer.

entities.name: Corlo
entities.description: Third Path savant in Terisia City as Mishra's army bore down.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Artificer who devised transmogrants and tried to get the sylex to Urza.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's apprentice who builds clay statues, drakes and the Stasis Coffin.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Phyrexian figure everywhere in the war, who pierces his disciples' minds and destroys Mishra.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: Leader who offered peace to Urza and whose people Mishra made pay for the insult.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Yotian aviator whose life Gwenna once spared.

entities.name: Gwenna
entities.description: Fighter who stayed her hand once to save young Harbin.

entities.name: Horance
entities.description: Urzan general who advises striking automatons at their predictable weakness.

entities.name: Rolf
entities.description: Argivian mechanic.

entities.name: Ani
entities.description: Urzan soldier.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: Mishra's loyal bodyguard.

entities.name: Sanwell
entities.description: Writer of a letter to his family complaining of rats.

entities.name: Laga
entities.description: Soldier who remarks on Mishra's lackeys living in luxury.

entities.name: Pero
entities.description: Man who called on a memory of a lightning storm in desperation.

entities.name: Myrel
entities.description: Shield of Argive who did not expect the ground itself to stand against them.

entities.name: Lognell
entities.description: Argivian scout.

entities.name: Kerish
entities.description: Urzan mechanist.

entities.name: Tergel
entities.description: Goblin explosioneer.

entities.name: Calle
entities.description: Urzan sergeant.

entities.name: Sharaman
entities.description: Urzan lieutenant.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: Builder of long-lasting automatons that outlasted the Thran.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: City of ivory towers that opened to all seeking respite and later fell to Mishra's army.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Capital of Yotia, leveled by Mishra.

entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: Realm of Urza, with capital Kroog, fought over with the Fallaji.

entities.name: Korlis
entities.description: Merchant state drawn into the conflict by Mishra's dragon engines.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Pristine island that the brothers plundered and whose defenders fought them.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria ravaged by the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane on which the Brothers' War takes place.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane whose nightmare returned after five thousand years.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: Desert people led by Mishra.

entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: Order of scholars in Terisia City.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Followers of Gix who whispered to Mishra.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: Ancient civilization whose machines lay dormant.

entities.name: sylex
entities.description: Powerful artifact seen by Loran as a key to the past, whose blast razed the land.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Artifact whose power bound a dragon engine to Mishra's command.

entities.name: powerstone
entities.description: Thran energy stones coveted by Urza, Mishra and others.

entities.name: The Stasis Coffin
entities.description: Impermeable device built by Tawnos.

entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: War between Urza and Mishra that ravaged Terisiare.

events.summary: The sylex blast razes the land and leaves Urza alone in the silence.
events.quote: Urza stood alone in the sudden silence.

events.summary: As Terisia City burns, Feldon presses the sylex into Loran's hands and urges her to run.
events.quote: As Terisia City burned, Feldon pressed the sylex into Loran's hands and urged her to run.

events.summary: Urza orders engineers to speed up production of machines for an army.
events.quote: "I need an army, not a masterpiece. Accelerate output, whatever it takes."

events.summary: Mishra's dragon engines draw Korlis into the war between Yotia and the Fallaji.
events.quote: Mishra's dragon engines changed that.

events.summary: Tocasia welcomes a young person, saying their father wanted her to look after them.
events.quote: "Your father was a dear friend to whom I owe much."

events.summary: Terisia City opens its ivory towers to all who sought respite from the war.
events.quote: Terisia City at last opened its ivory towers to all who sought respite from the endless war.

events.summary: Queen Kayla sends Yotian medics to save as many as they can as Kroog's walls fall.
events.quote: "Go, save as many as you can!

events.summary: Kaya cannot pull Teferi's spirit back before the temporal anchor fails and he is set adrift in time.
events.quote: he was set adrift in the currents of time.

events.summary: Saheeli forges the temporal anchor.
events.quote: The metal turned and blossomed with Saheeli's will

events.summary: Urza moves a statue, meeting the Warlord's condition to marry the princess.
events.quote: So Urza moved it.

events.summary: Hurkyl's followers show Mishra's army the secrets of the Third Path.
events.quote: Hurkyl's followers graciously showed them.

events.summary: The powerstone is split and the last shred of the brothers' bond breaks.
events.quote: As the glowing stone broke apart, so too did the last shred of the brothers' bond.

events.summary: The brothers fly the ancient thopter together, their last happy moment.
events.quote: flying the ancient thopter was their last happy moment together.

events.summary: Corlo prepares as Mishra's army bears down on Terisia City.
events.quote: As Mishra's army bore down on Terisia City

events.summary: Ashnod tells Tawnos to get the sylex to Urza at any cost.
events.quote: "Get the sylex to Urza at any cost.

events.summary: Gix pierces his disciples' minds and takes in their knowledge.
events.quote: Gix pierced his disciples' minds and savored their experiences as he took in their knowledge.

events.summary: The tide of war shifts in Mishra's favor.
events.quote: the tide of war shifted in Mishra's favor.

events.summary: Mishra dreams of Phyrexia.
events.quote: Mishra's nightmares of Phyrexia rang with screams of agony and groans of twisted metal.

events.summary: Urza turns down Titania's offer of peace and Mishra makes her people pay.
events.quote: When Titania offered peace, Urza merely turned her down.

events.summary: Mishra is gone, replaced by a machine wearing his face.
events.quote: Mishra was gone—all that remained was a machine wearing his face.

events.summary: Mishra flees after the explosion that kills Tocasia, never looking back.
events.quote: Mishra kept running and never once looked back.

events.summary: In his desperation to destroy Urza, Mishra lets Gix destroy him.
events.quote: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

events.summary: The peace summit shows the grudge between Urza and Mishra can end only in blood.
events.quote: The peace summit proved the grudge between Urza and Mishra could end only in blood.

events.summary: The brothers' rivalry becomes all-out enmity and Tocasia pays the price.
events.quote: The brothers' rivalry escalated into all-out enmity, and Tocasia paid the price.

events.summary: Mishra levels Kroog in retaliation for the Warlord's ambush at the peace summit.
events.quote: Mishra leveled Yotia's capital city.

events.summary: Power from the Weakstone binds a dragon engine to Mishra's command.
events.quote: Power radiated from the Weakstone, binding the dragon engine to Mishra's command.

events.summary: The brothers discover Argoth and the war becomes a race to plunder it.
events.quote: Once the brothers discovered the pristine island of Argoth, the war came down to who could plunder it faster.

events.summary: Mishra tells Urza he has let himself grow old and asks whether to talk or be slain.
events.quote: Shall we talk one last time, or must I slay you now?

events.summary: After five thousand years the nightmare of Phyrexia returns.
events.quote: After five thousand years, the nightmare returned.

events.summary: Urza betrays the Sardian dwarves, who call on their neighbors for aid.
events.quote: When Urza betrayed the Sardian dwarves, they called upon the might of their neighbors for aid.

relations.quote: Loran was the true heir to her legacy.

relations.note: Urza and Mishra were Tocasia's famous students
relations.quote: Urza and Mishra may have been Tocasia's most famous students

relations.note: Urza and Mishra were Tocasia's famous students
relations.quote: Urza and Mishra may have been Tocasia's most famous students
The brothers' rivalry escalated into all-out enmity, and Tocasia paid the price.
The brothers' rivalry escalated into all-out enmity, and Tocasia paid the price.
Alongside his wife, Hurkyl, Drafna built a legacy of scholarship that endured for millennia.
"I've stood by Mishra's side from the beginning. I will not abandon him now."
While his master tried to surpass nature, Tawnos aimed to capture its beauty.
In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.
